name: Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or clasped lightly in front of your chest.
Step forward and bend both knees, lowering your rear knee toward the floor while keeping your front heel planted.
Push firmly through the midfoot and heel of your front foot to return to the upright starting stance.
Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your torso tall and prevent your front knee from collapsing inward as you step forward.
Take a stride long enough that your front heel stays planted flat on the floor.
